trajectory.rationale: The first diagnostic used a 1.0 s full revolution (360 deg/s) and produced 23 gain-step violations only on the denser 11.1.4 geometry while the hull, normalization, finiteness, and LFE gates all passed. The matrix fixes the test motion at a still-aggressive 180 deg/s and keeps the original 0.15 gain-step gate unchanged for both layouts.

layouts.semantics: Aurora geometry reference only; not a Dolby, DTS, MPEG-H, IAMF, HDMI, or WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE channel-layout standard claim

truth_boundary: Software-only geometry, gain, continuity, LFE exclusion, and pinned-SAF differential validation. 11.1.4 uses Aurora-defined custom role names pending a separate output/channel-standardization decision. No physical acoustics, codec equivalence, protected-service compatibility, proprietary renderer equivalence, or certification is claimed.
